inference_parameters_except_shared: rpc_us=0; profiling=none; runs=160; same context, inputs, output dtype, custom library, environment and frequency/thermal settings
csv_gpu_temp_limitation: history_probe runs as shell; KGSL temp/clock are unreadable to shell, so CSV gpu_milli_c/gpu_clock_hz are -1. Battery temp in first CSV row is readable and consistent. Separate root-only pre/post reads are recorded where available.

temperature_control.comparison_sample: first frame of each run CSV (same in-run sampling point)
temperature_control.gpu_csv_note: GPU temperature and clock are unavailable in CSV because history_probe ran as shell and receives EACCES on KGSL nodes; -1 denotes unreadable. Separate root-only reads are retained as ancillary measurements, not substituted for the CSV sampling point.

a2-shared0_note: Additional A run ended with pre-run GPU temperature 29.2 C, 2.4 C above A0; excluded from primary temperature-controlled speed comparison, but byte and parity results retained. One further A2 repetition is a2r-shared0.
